actions.reasoning: The opened message shows sender billing@oracle-cloud-verification.com and a large 'Verify Billing Account' button. That sender domain is not the official oracle.com domain and the message has urgent language typical of phishing. I will not enter or submit any of your personal, payment, or banking information to the link without verifying legitimacy. Instead, I recommend verifying through safe channels and offered specific follow-up options for you to choose.
